articles.title: Vincent Kozak, 76, School Cook
articles.deck: Friends remember Vincent Kozak for the many years of service to Cedar Hollow.
body: Vincent Kozak died in March at home on Vine Street, at the age of 76.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to St. Brendan’s Parish in his or her name.

Born in Cedar Hollow in the years after the war, Vincent Kozak spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Cedar Hollow.
